title: KTM North America Recalls Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Fall or Crash Hazard
summary: The motorcycle handlebar clamp can develop cracks during normal use causing the handlebars to move from their set position. This can result in the rider losing control of the vehicle, posing a fall or crash hazard. Units: About 6,117.

title: Target Recalls to Repair Embark Resistance Cords Due to Injury Hazard
summary: A black plastic ball attached to the resistance cord's door anchor can unexpectedly release and strike the user, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 447,000.

title: LED Night Lights Recalled by Camsing Global Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The LED night lights can overheat, smolder, and melt which may cause minor burns to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: Wooden Rattle Recalled by Manhattan Group Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The toy's U-shaped parts can break, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 3,300 in the United States and 145 in Canada.

title: Bridgeway Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The bicycle chain can break, causing a rider to lose control and fall. Units: About 91,000.

title: Specialized Bicycle Components Recalls Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The brake component housed within the bicycle's carbon fork can disengage from the fork and allow the brake assembly to contact the wheel spokes while rotating, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 14,200.

title: American Woodcrafters Recalls to Repair Bunk Beds Due To Fall Hazard
summary: The guard rails on upper bunks can crack and cause the mattress and its support rails to collapse, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 180.

title: John Deere Recalls Lawn Tractors Powered by Kawasaki Engines Due to Overheating and Fire Hazards
summary: The cooling fan (A) installed on top of the front mounted Kawasaki engine in the lawn tractor can break. If the cooling fan is not operational, the engine can overheat causing the surrounding plastic to melt, creating the risk of fire and serious injury. Units: About 36,500 tractors.

title: Target, Select Brands Recall Chefmate Blender Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: While in operation, the plastic pitcher can separate from the blade assembly, leaving the blade assembly in the base and exposing the rotating blades. This poses a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 304,000.

title: Home Fires Prompt Dehumidifier Recall Reannouncement from LG Electronics
summary: The power connector for the dehumidifier's compressor can short circuit, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers and their property. Units: About 98,000.

title: John Deere Recalls Lawn Tractors Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: Hardware used to hold the mower blade brake assemblies on the mower decks can break. This can cause the mower blades to spin longer than normal after the operator turns off the power, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 15,500.

title: John Deere Recalls Lawn Tractors; Brake Failure Can Cause Loss of Control
summary: Hardware used to hold the brake assembly to the transmission housing can break. This can cause the brakes to fail, posing an injury hazard due to loss of control. Units: About 5,200.

title: Kubota Recalls Riding Mowers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The fuel hose clamp can detach from the fuel filter and allow gas to leak out, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 6,100.

title: Weehoo Recalls Bike Trailers Due to Fall and Crash Hazards
summary: The receiver on the trailer's seat post hitch can crack and cause the trailer to detach, posing fall and crash hazards to the child in the seat. Units: About 2,700.

title: Husqvarna Professional Products Recalls RedMax Brushcutter Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Some fuel tanks allow leakage at the fuel cap, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,500.

title: Musical Wooden Table Toys Recalled by Battat Due to Choking Hazard
